rows.label: ins:introduction:neutrality-is-dignity
rows.statement: Participants must be able to inspect and reproduce the measure of standing.

rows.label: ins:introduction:price-not-detector
rows.statement: Admission uses burn solvency and safety and participation floors rather than a humanity detector.

rows.label: ins:introduction:equal-among-peers
rows.statement: Standing pools transported balances and action counts rather than averaging actor rates.

rows.label: ins:introduction:no-escape-velocity
rows.statement: Certified fixed-rung relational support cannot be replaced by artifact routing.

rows.label: ins:introduction:peer-claim-scope
rows.statement: Incoming action mass controls peer convergence and an isolated actor retains its own source rate.

rows.label: ins:introduction:only-faithful-coordinate
rows.statement: The distributional comparison uses costly commitment per action rather than aggregate reserves.

rows.label: ins:introduction:the-floor-we-name
rows.statement: Public accountability does not prove the truth of every graph claim.

rows.label: ins:introduction:the-cut-no-mechanism-can-make
rows.statement: Internal graph evidence cannot distinguish funded genuine participants from funded fabrications.

rows.label: ins:introduction:vouch-not-check
rows.statement: Record accountable authored vouches without recording or certifying private identity checks.

rows.label: ins:introduction:right-to-leave
rows.statement: Payload erasure preserves the structural residue on which other actors rely.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:two-layers-derived
rows.statement: Layer 1 reads the external burn interface and publishes reproducible conserved standing while guilds own terminal readouts.

rows.label: tbl:introduction:layer-roles
rows.statement: Separate external frame supply, network binding, and terminal consumer roles.

rows.label: post:introduction:public-accessibility
rows.statement: Graph and ledger remain publicly readable without authentication.

rows.label: post:introduction:record-integrity
rows.statement: Published records and ledger entries cannot be silently changed.

rows.label: post:introduction:irrevocability
rows.statement: Retain irreversible ledger history and monotone pinned imported burn values.

rows.label: post:introduction:authoritative-act-order
rows.statement: Publish a dependency-respecting total act order whose positions define logical times.

rows.label: post:introduction:epoch-edge-set
rows.statement: Each boundary supplies a finite monotone causally closed edge set.

rows.label: rem:introduction:mechanism-agnostic
rows.statement: Any provider mechanism must establish agreement on the ordered acts as well as the edge set.

rows.label: subsec:introduction:verification-model
rows.statement: Audit and gated deployment phases share formulas and publicly reproducible verification.

rows.label: ax:comparator:inter-cluster
rows.statement: A meaningful comparison requires exogenous source rather than topology alone.

rows.label: rem:comparator:topology-is-gauge
rows.statement: Graph geometry alone cannot certify costly source.

rows.label: rem:comparator:actor-field-cluster-comparison
rows.statement: Publish actor standing without prescribing social cluster partitions or aggregation.

rows.label: def:comparator:burn-primitive
rows.statement: The imported primitive must record costly irreversible publicly verifiable destruction.

rows.label: def:comparator:burn-interface
rows.statement: Expose burn values, opaque addresses, bootstrap capacity, and unit-cost projection only.

rows.label: post:comparator:burn-primitive
rows.statement: Require R1 through R11 including settled provenance, nontransferability, capacity, cost and conditional operator bounds.

rows.label: post:comparator:frame-requirements
rows.statement: This second label aliases the same R1 through R11 realization obligations.

rows.label: def:comparator:imported-frame
rows.statement: Read a shared nonnegative burn-value codomain at each permanently bound actor address.

rows.label: eq:comparator:seam
rows.statement: Resolve an actor burn value through its bound primitive address.

rows.label: rem:comparator:neutrality-from-silence
rows.statement: The imported destruction record confers no primitive-level priced claim.

rows.label: def:comparator:frame-binding
rows.statement: Keep each actor permanently bound to its opaque burn address.

rows.label: rem:comparator:destination-funding-non-transferability
rows.statement: Allow destination-funded new accrual without representing a funder or transferring recorded source.

rows.label: rem:comparator:identity-is-layer-2
rows.statement: Do not represent the person associated with an actor in Layer 1.

rows.label: lem:comparator:frame-stability
rows.statement: Settled burn snapshots cannot decrease across epochs.

rows.label: rem:comparator:auditability
rows.statement: Verify destruction provenance rather than treating a sum of records as sufficient burn evidence.

rows.label: def:comparator:rate
rows.statement: Divide residual balance by the greater of cumulative accepted-act count and one.

rows.label: eq:comparator:rate
rows.statement: Compute the neutral source from residual balance and guarded count.

rows.label: def:comparator:residual-balance
rows.statement: Subtract historical consummated debits at their original epoch prices from imported burn.

rows.label: eq:comparator:residual-balance
rows.statement: Calculate residual burn as imported value less the debit schedule.

rows.label: rem:comparator:vintage-trichotomy
rows.statement: Preserve recorded parameters and debit vintages while reading carried balances under current constants.

rows.label: rem:comparator:type-asymmetry
rows.statement: Distinguish burn magnitudes from integer counts and reduce through the numeraire.

rows.label: def:comparator:numeraire
rows.statement: Use a positive burn-per-action numeraire as the sole dimensional conversion.

rows.label: ins:comparator:inherited-costliness
rows.statement: Treat costliness and provenance as obligations supplied by the realization.

rows.label: def:comparator:source-faithful
rows.statement: Separate inherited actor-source authenticity from the bounded truth of edge claims.

rows.label: post:comparator:accountability-cost
rows.statement: Keep attributed immutable public claims while making no guarantee of their external truth.

rows.label: tbl:comparator:two-costs
rows.statement: Distinguish exogenous source cost from endogenous accountability cost.

rows.label: post:comparator:faithfulness
rows.statement: Enforce source, dimensional, immutable-ledger, conservation, epoch-set, title, memoryless, universal, domain, tilt, cluster-rate and final-state clauses.

rows.label: ins:comparator:universal-amplifier
rows.statement: Terminal value channels use dimensionless standing amplification without manufacturing source.

rows.label: rem:comparator:amplifier-rendering
rows.statement: Terminal amplification must not silently become an admission-policy control.

rows.label: rem:comparator:conserved-allocation-scope
rows.statement: Conservation proves rivalry but neither target consent, actor-split invariance nor a standing movement cap.

rows.label: cor:comparator:sybil-resistance-is-faithfulness
rows.statement: Fabricated zero-source passive structure cannot manufacture standing.

rows.label: def:comparator:bootstrap-capacity
rows.statement: Carry the realization-published aggregate pre-market burn bound without deriving it.

rows.label: eq:comparator:admission-benchmark-deposits
rows.statement: Multiply unsupported-act burn benchmarks by the realization unit-cost projection.

rows.label: tbl:comparator:admission-benchmarks
rows.statement: Check debit-only, safety and door-neutral unsupported-act costs separately.

rows.label: rem:comparator:network-prices-the-frame
rows.statement: Derive standing from imported source without importing a realization monetary mechanism.

rows.label: rem:comparator:surface-readings
rows.statement: Exclude monetary-surface quantities while carrying the additional published R9 through R11 constants.

rows.label: rem:comparator:inherited-limitations
rows.statement: Do not claim burn net-cost or actor-splitting guarantees from nontransferability alone.

rows.label: rem:comparator:structural-ceiling
rows.statement: No calibration can make endogenous edge corroboration an exogenous truth guarantee.

rows.label: def:network:write
rows.statement: Publish the accepted ordered act sequence and its whole dependent-set projections only after final-state validity.

rows.label: rem:network:not-a-write
rows.statement: Do not publish rejected candidates, solver iterates, derived edges or payload reductions as writes.

rows.label: def:network:admission-closure
rows.statement: Classify every value by whether its arithmetic or validity read-sites feed admission.

rows.label: rem:network:boundary-one-sentence
rows.statement: Keep binding ledger, formation, recognition and standing inputs separate from replaceable terminal formulas.

rows.label: def:network:object-taxonomy
rows.statement: Distinguish imported, binding, verification, optional byproduct and terminal objects.

rows.label: def:network:conserved-standing-package
rows.statement: Publish completed inputs, fold/base data, activation, rung history, transport, emissions, standing and reproduction evidence.

rows.label: tbl:network:object-taxonomy
rows.statement: Apply the five permission classes to published values according to their read-sites.

rows.label: rem:network:taxonomy-subtleties
rows.statement: Separate binding certificate verdicts from evidence and never let optional caches feed binding outputs.

rows.label: rem:network:within-epoch-solve-freeze
rows.statement: Freeze the completed-set base matrix and ledger-derived emissions throughout a solve.

rows.label: post:network:host-contract
rows.statement: Publish all seven package parts and decisive standing enclosures without hidden state or normative digests.

rows.label: def:network:door-headroom
rows.statement: Sum final stamp surplus once per accepted act as a non-actuating diagnostic.

rows.label: rem:network:durations-no-glyph
rows.statement: Publish duration policy, closure cause and attested timestamp without inventing a formula-derived clock.

rows.label: ins:network:back-pressure
rows.statement: Separate epoch budget and timing selection from the greatest-certifiable-rung search.

rows.label: ax:graph:authored-act-ontology
rows.statement: Accepted acts own all authoritative fields and project to edges; nodes and their properties are derived readings.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-ownership-invariant
rows.statement: An edge projection cannot independently change any parent-owned approval, payload, debit or clock.

rows.label: cor:graph:hyper-act-indivisibility
rows.statement: Both hyper-act projections share exactly one lifecycle and accounting unit.

rows.label: rem:graph:ontology-promotion
rows.statement: Treat accepted acts as authored history and every edge as a derived projection.

rows.label: def:graph:identifier-algebra
rows.statement: Represent addresses, profiles, exact names and act-minted identifiers as disjoint constructors.

rows.label: def:graph:authored-act
rows.statement: Represent one atomic act with one binary or two matched hyper-edge projections.

rows.label: def:graph:act-identifier
rows.statement: Form identity from author, local sequence and family before host time or target minting.

rows.label: lem:graph:identifier-disjointness
rows.statement: Decide identifier class from its constructor without a lookup.

rows.label: def:graph:anchoring
rows.statement: Distinguish reference from class-specific anchoring and dangling state.

rows.label: lem:graph:dangling-neutral-fold
rows.statement: Return neutral folds for referenced identifiers lacking their required anchor.

rows.label: def:graph:node-taxonomy
rows.statement: Classify grounded Actor/Profile, named Type and six minted artifact kinds.

rows.label: rem:graph:name-equality
rows.statement: Compare names by exact bytes without Unicode normalization or case folding.

rows.label: def:graph:genesis-act-and-creator
rows.statement: Detect self-minting genesis roles and derive creators by identifier class.

rows.label: def:graph:registration
rows.statement: Anchor an existing grounded Actor/Profile pair through an ordinary priced act.

rows.label: def:graph:derived-raw-edges
rows.statement: Derive current raw Self readings from accepted standing without appending records.

rows.label: def:graph:raw-traversal-snapshot
rows.statement: Combine accepted edges with current derived Self readings for terminal traversal only.

rows.label: def:graph:derived-self-reading
rows.statement: Derive both Self components from the same reduced standing and tenure maturity.

rows.label: def:graph:raw-snapshot-path
rows.statement: Use bounded simple paths in the current raw snapshot without increasing-time constraints.

rows.label: thm:graph:raw-weight-ceiling
rows.statement: Raw canonical edge weights are nonnegative and strictly below one.

rows.label: def:graph:canonical-folds
rows.statement: Derive declared node properties from records and keep title binding while terminal folds remain replaceable.

rows.label: rem:graph:stance-records-by-family
rows.statement: Exclude control and derived records from stance means but retain genesis stance fields.

rows.label: lem:graph:act-edge-identifier-uniqueness
rows.statement: Reject duplicate accepted act and projection identities as equivocation.

rows.label: ax:graph:parallel-authored-acts
rows.statement: Retain parallel acts individually without rejection, merging or implicit supersession.

rows.label: def:graph:authored-act-bundle
rows.statement: Group complete acts by author, incidence and family without reconstructing acts from unrelated legs.

rows.label: def:graph:act-edge-projection
rows.statement: Project one parent act into role-consistent edges inheriting its single time and semantic tuple.

rows.label: rem:graph:authored-act-bundle-consumers
rows.statement: Reserve binding bundle interpretations to standing compilation and title recognition.

rows.label: rem:graph:terminal-folds-alter-nothing
rows.statement: Terminal selection leaves all accepted records live for accounting and binding consumers.

rows.label: post:graph:title-act-bundle-reservation
rows.statement: Resolve settlement bundles at epoch granularity with cancellation dominance and mutual consumption.

rows.label: rem:graph:profile-update
rows.statement: A parallel Registration updates payload history without rebinding identity.

rows.label: def:graph:chain-ordered-revision-head
rows.statement: Terminal revision selection follows public ancestry and preserves the incumbent across branches.

rows.label: prop:graph:revision-head-order-invariance
rows.statement: The canonical terminal revision head is independent of valid host linearization.

rows.label: rem:graph:chain-requirement-sited-in-fold
rows.statement: Do not add revision-chain lookups to syntactic formation or turn declared parents into scoring incidence.

rows.label: def:graph:canonical-erasure-default
rows.statement: The terminal default selects structurally before rendering and never falls back from a reduced head.

rows.label: rem:graph:parallel-undefined
rows.statement: Do not invent additional binding interpretations of parallel records.

rows.label: rem:graph:grounded-target-does-not-imply-allocation
rows.statement: A grounded endpoint alone cannot confer standing authority.

rows.label: rem:graph:right-to-leave-completed
rows.statement: Keep removable content separate from immutable relied-upon structure for every act kind.

rows.label: def:graph:partition
rows.statement: Derive active Actor and passive artifact partitions from projected records.

rows.label: ax:graph:passivity
rows.statement: Every accepted act has an Actor author and passive nodes cannot autonomously redirect edges.

rows.label: prop:graph:author-source-identity
rows.statement: The initiating source, identifier author and authenticated actor must agree.

rows.label: lem:graph:passive-out-degree
rows.statement: Passive outgoing projections are authored hyper-act terminal legs plus the separate raw Profile reading.

rows.label: rem:graph:asymmetry
rows.statement: An actor-directed act implies no reciprocal act or symmetric parameters.

rows.label: ax:graph:act-causality
rows.statement: Assign one act-level Lamport event and enforce earlier parents and dependencies.

rows.label: def:graph:act-incidence-causality
rows.statement: Compute binary or three-way incidence frontiers and pair Lamport time with host position.

rows.label: rem:graph:causal-frontier-not-ancestry
rows.statement: Never infer a causal parent solely from a smaller clock.

rows.label: def:graph:edge-projection-maturity
rows.statement: Compute each projection maturity from shared pre-act endpoint degree without sibling self-maturation.

rows.label: def:graph:authoritative-act-order
rows.statement: Retain total host order and its causal key while checking declared precedence.

rows.label: rem:graph:host-ordering-discretion
rows.statement: Publish residual host ordering choices without promising incentive-neutral order.

rows.label: prop:graph:act-clock-path-order
rows.statement: The stated projected-path rule requires increasing act keys except within one hyper-act.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-time-not-wall-clock
rows.statement: Compute logical timing and maturity without substituting wall-clock time.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-ordering-relations
rows.statement: Keep public parents distinct from removable dependencies and exclude both from direct scoring incidence.

rows.label: rem:graph:maturity-max-rationale
rows.statement: The canonical maturity uses maximum endpoint degree to retain sparse-to-dense context.

rows.label: prop:graph:maturity-bounds
rows.statement: Finite-degree maturity remains in the half-open unit interval and grows with degree.

rows.label: def:graph:temporal-entropy
rows.statement: Evaluate binary entropy of maturity with the zero endpoint totalized.

rows.label: def:graph:act-payload-projection
rows.statement: Carry one bounded opaque payload per act with a retained commitment and removable opening.

rows.label: post:graph:separable-act-projections
rows.statement: Require independently verifiable structure and binding concealing payload residue with atomic opening removal.

rows.label: def:graph:act-payload-state
rows.statement: Distinguish full-empty, full and reduced payload states with one-way reduction.

rows.label: prop:graph:removable-projection-invariance
rows.statement: Payload or dependency tombstones preserve structural identities and all computed binding quantities.

rows.label: def:graph:act-payload-controller
rows.statement: Assign payload removal control to the act author, never independently to a leg.

rows.label: rem:graph:payload-size-not-act-cost
rows.statement: Charge one act regardless of its bounded payload size.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-payload-removal-neutrality
rows.statement: Replay standing and title identically with full or reduced content.

rows.label: rem:graph:act-payload-custody-phases
rows.statement: Change carriage responsibility across phases while retaining the same witness and structural record.

rows.label: rem:graph:erasure-floor
rows.statement: Retain concealing residue and do not promise erasure of other authors' quotations or proof of payload authorship.

rows.label: def:graph:sentiment-slice
rows.statement: Construct the masked three-by-three slice with always-active marginals and baseline.

rows.label: rem:graph:marginal-archetypes
rows.statement: Check that strong marginal direction survives weak bilinear intensity.

rows.label: prop:graph:rank-two-constraint
rows.statement: Check mask-dependent singular-value bounds rather than assuming exact rank two after clamping.

rows.label: prop:graph:rank-two-constraint:energy-share
rows.statement: Check the claimed two-singular-value energy shares by mask.

rows.label: ins:graph:rank-two-structural-consequence
rows.statement: Compose the two-by-two path view and retain the full Frobenius attribution view.

rows.label: def:graph:dual-view-architecture
rows.statement: Expose scalar, path-view and attribution-view extractions separately.

rows.label: tbl:graph:computational-interfaces
rows.statement: Keep raw geometry consumers separate from complete-act standing compilation.

rows.label: def:graph:path-view-extraction
rows.statement: Extract the softened bilinear block with Full, Half and Marginal routing floors.

rows.label: def:graph:signed-svd
rows.statement: Decompose nonsingular two-by-two matrices into proper rotations, singular magnitudes and orientation.

rows.label: lem:graph:signed-svd-uniqueness
rows.statement: Distinct singular values determine the dominant axis up to simultaneous rotation sign.

rows.label: def:graph:coherence-ratio
rows.statement: Return the singular-value ratio and handle the isotropic endpoint explicitly.

rows.label: def:graph:dominant-mode-angle
rows.statement: Compute the acute dominant-axis angle only when that axis is defined.

rows.label: rem:graph:signed-svd-geometric-mean
rows.statement: At half diversity use the determinant magnitude while signed consumers retain parity.

rows.label: rem:graph:score-exponent-uniqueness
rows.statement: Keep the stated determinant square-root exponent distinct from freely tunable terminal rendering.

rows.label: rem:graph:trace-determinant-recovery
rows.statement: Recover determinant from signed singular values and trace only with the relative rotation.

rows.label: def:graph:determinant-sign
rows.statement: Extract orientation only for nonzero determinant.

rows.label: rem:graph:one-bit-extraction-cost
rows.statement: Parity extraction reuses the determinant already computed for raw magnitude.

rows.label: prop:graph:pipeline-anisotropy
rows.statement: Canonical nonzero-parameter path views have distinct singular values.

rows.label: rem:graph:zero-parameter-degeneracy
rows.statement: Zero-parameter edges are routing-inert with undefined parity but may still anchor title.

rows.label: prop:graph:path-view-determinant-bound
rows.statement: Check nonvanishing determinants and tier-dependent reference bounds without imposing reference bands as universal caps.

rows.label: lem:graph:tier-floor-sign-invariance
rows.statement: Half-tier attenuation preserves the full-block determinant sign.

rows.label: lem:graph:quadrant-law
rows.statement: Parity equals the semantic-parameter product sign and survives a joint sign flip.

rows.label: rem:graph:sign-semantics
rows.statement: Do not substitute coherence parity for positive semantic stance in standing eligibility.

rows.label: def:graph:augmented-tensor
rows.statement: Form temporal augmentation with the Frobenius factorization.

rows.label: thm:graph:maturity-amplification
rows.statement: Temporal norm amplification rises from one toward square root two.

rows.label: def:graph:path-matrix
rows.statement: Multiply path-view matrices in the selected raw path order.

rows.label: prop:graph:polarization-self-reinforcement
rows.statement: Apply the polarization lower bound only when the cross term is nonnegative.

rows.label: thm:graph:svd-composition-bounds
rows.statement: Check upper and lower singular-value product bounds under composition.

rows.label: thm:graph:determinant-product
rows.statement: Path determinant equals the product of edge determinants.

rows.label: cor:graph:condition-number-submultiplicativity
rows.statement: Bound path condition number by the product of edge condition numbers.

rows.label: rem:graph:order-sensitivity
rows.statement: Distinguish order-sensitive path matrices from order-independent determinant products.

rows.label: lem:graph:ordered-replay-determinism
rows.statement: The same ordered history and constants reproduce all declared graph readings.

rows.label: cor:graph:path-parity-sign
rows.statement: Compose path parity by multiplying edge orientation signs.

rows.label: def:graph:svd-path-score
rows.statement: Compute the two-singular-value diversity score with maturity and boundary damping.

rows.label: rem:graph:diversity-preference-default
rows.statement: The half-diversity default yields scalar determinant factorization.

rows.label: tbl:graph:extraction-tiering
rows.statement: Compute determinant scalars per edge and reserve richer diagnostics for declared consumers.

rows.label: def:graph:path-distance
rows.statement: Minimize raw reciprocal determinant-maturity costs without boundary damping.

rows.label: lem:graph:non-vanishing-norm
rows.statement: The always-active baseline gives a positive slice norm floor.

rows.label: lem:graph:frobenius-bound
rows.statement: Bound the nine-entry slice Frobenius norm by three.

rows.label: prop:graph:polarization-floor
rows.statement: Preserve baseline and polarization floors across canonical masks.

rows.label: rem:graph:path-shortening-tendency
rows.statement: The stated path-shortening tendency is conditional on the sign of the cross term.

rows.label: def:graph:anisotropy-penalty
rows.statement: Compute the analytical SVD-versus-Frobenius log-cost diagnostic without using it as a routing input.

rows.label: prop:graph:svd-score-properties
rows.statement: Check stated strength, diversity and weak-link score properties within their declared domains.

rows.label: prop:graph:coherence-decay-bound
rows.statement: Bound path coherence decay by the geometric mean of edge condition numbers.

rows.label: thm:graph:frobenius-upper-bound
rows.statement: Bound the dominant singular value by path Frobenius norm and edge norm products.

rows.label: rem:graph:path-frame-convention
rows.statement: Interpret path diagnostics in the first edge intensity frame.

rows.label: tbl:graph:sentiment-archetypes
rows.statement: Terminal archetype presentation does not alter scoring.

rows.label: def:graph:aggregated-sentiment
rows.statement: Compute declared incoming sentiment means for the terminal content scalar.

rows.label: def:graph:hyper-edge-scalar-interface
rows.statement: Use the product of matched raw-leg norms as a raw consistency identity, never a standing coefficient.

rows.label: thm:graph:hyper-edge-reduction
rows.statement: Keep raw scalar, path-view, attribution and complete-act standing reductions distinct.

rows.label: cor:graph:standing-act-atomicity
rows.statement: Accept a designated complete hyper-act for standing or contribute no outward standing through it.

rows.label: tbl:graph:interaction-domains
rows.statement: Represent domain masks and distinguish defaults from the normative per-family census.

rows.label: def:graph:mask-promotion-criterion
rows.statement: Promote signed target-stance masks according to the census rather than self-report semantics.

rows.label: def:graph:proposal-half-tier
rows.statement: Apply Half routing floors to settlement and conversational proposal families while preserving stored slices.

rows.label: def:graph:item-genesis-act
rows.statement: Root Item title only in its self-minting Owner act.

rows.label: rem:graph:item-identity-limit
rows.statement: Treat title as ownership of a registered claim, not proof of a real-world referent.

rows.label: def:graph:settlement-act-reference
rows.statement: Accept and Ratify name the Bid act, and Ratify also names the exact Accept.

rows.label: def:graph:act-causal-parents
rows.statement: Retain backward public causal references as immutable metadata without graph incidence.

rows.label: def:graph:dependent-act-set
rows.statement: Close candidate acts under causal ancestors and retain whole hyper-act projections.

rows.label: cor:graph:act-projection-atomicity
rows.statement: Admit both hyper-act projections together without introducing a causal cycle.

rows.label: rem:graph:dependency-closure-excludes-conflicts
rows.statement: Do not expand causal dependency closure to concurrent cancellation conflicts.

rows.label: def:graph:public-protocol-reference
rows.statement: Keep formation and settlement references available after every removable projection is tombstoned.

rows.label: def:graph:act-removable-projections
rows.statement: Model content and dependency openings separately over immutable commitment residues.

rows.label: def:graph:act-dependency-projection
rows.statement: Encode a bounded versioned sorted unique act-identifier set with explicit empty and tombstoned states.

rows.label: def:graph:act-dependency-tombstone
rows.statement: Remove dependency carriage without deleting or recomputing finalized structural history.

rows.label: def:graph:proposal-pre-commitment
rows.statement: Bind the actor proposal and requested projection states before host salts or ordering.

rows.label: def:graph:verified-act
rows.statement: Represent the validated host-sealed header with separate commitment editions and no order fields.

rows.label: def:graph:approval-witness
rows.statement: Only the exact actor-approved verified act is eligible for candidate ordering.

rows.label: def:graph:ordering-fraud-proof
rows.statement: An ordinary full dependency opening can demonstrate a finalized ordering violation.

rows.label: post:graph:ordering-accountability
rows.statement: A successful ordering fraud proof attributes fault without rewriting final history.

rows.label: post:graph:act-authentication-requirements
rows.statement: Require authorship, integrity, visible host additions, exact approval, hyper-act unity and retained binding.

rows.label: rem:graph:authentication-realization-out-of-scope
rows.statement: Leave cryptographic algorithms, key management and wire realization to explicit deployment decisions.

rows.label: def:graph:act-finalization-epoch
rows.statement: Identify the first accepted epoch of an act and compare title events at that granularity.

rows.label: def:graph:act-envelope
rows.statement: Publish the accepted act identifier, author, family, body, protocol references, causal parents, commitments, handshake, approval witness, finalization epoch and act time as an abstract envelope, with payload bytes, salts and dependency opening beside it and serialization left to deployment.

rows.label: def:graph:settlement-recognition
rows.statement: Check the six recognition clauses including prior ownership and co-epoch cancellation precedence.

rows.label: rem:graph:title-order-irrelevance
rows.statement: Title uses epoch membership and reference-forced handshake order rather than host tie-breaking.

rows.label: post:graph:boundary-accountability
rows.statement: Publish partition, constraints, closure cause and timestamp while granting no inclusion rights.

rows.label: rem:graph:settlement-clause-structure
rows.statement: Recognition reads membership, pointers, prior title and epoch indices without audit positions.

rows.label: def:graph:ownership-thread
rows.statement: Follow boundary transfers from genesis and distinguish failed claims from ordinary description updates.

rows.label: def:graph:settlement-consumption
rows.statement: Consume every recognized unchallenged co-epoch candidate permanently even when conflicts prevent transfer.

rows.label: def:graph:title-certificate
rows.statement: Map each Item to its thread terminal owner or void.

rows.label: thm:graph:epoch-title-fold
rows.statement: Transfer on one candidate, retain incumbent on zero or multiple candidates, and consume conflicts.

rows.label: rem:graph:regret-window
rows.statement: Treat the boundary certificate as finality and keep cancellation subject to inclusion.

rows.label: rem:graph:cancellation-best-effort
rows.statement: Cancellation wins an admitted co-epoch tie but has no guaranteed delivery.

rows.label: thm:graph:settlement-order-freeness
rows.statement: Preserve title under residual sub-epoch permutations of a fixed epoch partition.

rows.label: thm:graph:no-death-by-inaction
rows.statement: Require authored settlement transitions rather than per-object expiry.

rows.label: rem:graph:causal-locality-principle
